What should I do if the tracking never updates?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
If your tracking number shows no updates, this can be normal at first.
After the shipping label is created, it may take a few days for the courier to pick up and scan the package. Until the first scan, tracking may appear inactive. 
Couriers sometimes delay scans during busy periods or due to system backlogs.
What you can do:
Wait a few days and check the tracking again on the courier’s website.
If there are still no updates after several days, contact the courier directly with the tracking number to ask about the shipment status.
If the tracking remains stalled for 3–5 business days and the courier cannot provide information, you can follow up here so the situation can be reviewed further.
